name: images_reimagine
description: Only when the user explicitly asks to reimagine. A new image, or a rework of one, is `images_generate`. Re-renders the source with the same composition. Then `creations_show`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

keepStructure.description: Lock the layout with a depth pass. Flux only. Default false.

mode.description: flux (default, best quality) | fast | imagen-nano-banana (prompt-driven, keeps every element).

prompt.description: What the new take should look like. Optional.

strength.description: 0..1 how far to drift from the source. Default 0.6. 1 drops the source.
